name: Isekai Kareshi
source:
After stepping on a mysterious magic circle, the heroine lands in a world of swords and magic. She is faced with many problems, starting from a sword being pointed at her by a scary looking knight, to getting involved in an assassination of the crown prince.

Making full use of her power that blossomed in the isekai, such as the power to use recovery magic, the heroine spends 3 months in the isekai till she’s able to get back to the original world, with great positivity―

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20210818173403/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.quads.isekai]Google Play[/url]]
